reviews.reason: The primary CIF parses and round-trips as an explicit, ordered, fully occupied 18-atom primitive cell with Ta3V3Si12 (reduced TaVSi4, Z=3), a=4.721354, b=13.005342, c=4.704417 angstrom, beta=120.434755 degrees, and volume 249.06085 angstrom^3. Although written redundantly in P1, its explicit coordinates symmetry-detect as P2, so no atoms or ordering are missing. The instantiated CIF covers the important reflections, including the diagnostic 001-006 and split monoclinic families, with no important unexplained line; its 5-90 degree whole-profile comparison has correlation 0.99598 and equal-weight R=8.65%. The residual is partly peak-shape-limited (a free-intensity fit using the same simple common profile remains at 4.84% below 50 degrees versus approximately 0.10 intensity-unit off-peak noise), while integrated cluster intensities correlate at 0.996 and the Si-coordinate scan/refinement has a defined minimum near x=0.1599. All 20 Ta/V assignments on the instantiated framework were compared; the exactly tied best assignment is structure-matched to the submitted ordering at sub-femtometer fractional tolerance, while powder-distinct assignments fit worse. Periodic chemistry passes: the minimum separation is 2.526 angstrom, Si-Si and metal-Si contacts are plausible, and each metal has a complete 10-Si first shell. No concrete diffraction-compatible incompatible realization survives, so another attempt is unlikely to add a materially different viable candidate.
